vibe: Premium, distinctive, bold, cinematic, dark mode. No AI-slop violet/purple gradients.

layout.global_structure: Flex row on desktop (lg:flex-row), flex col on mobile. Sidebar: w-full lg:w-72 or 80. Content pane: flex-1.
layout.sidebar_progress_rail: Persistent left side. Glassmorphism background. Vertical step list using Lucide icons (Circle, CheckCircle). Active step text-white, inactive text-zinc-500.
layout.content_pane: Centered content. max-w-3xl w-full mx-auto p-6 sm:p-12.
layout.language_picker: Absolute top-right position on the content pane (z-50).

wizard_steps.title: Welcome
wizard_steps.design_instructions: Hero layout. Full cover background image with heavy linear gradient overlay (to black). Large WatchNexus logo/mark. Huge H1 'Your Media, Mastered.' Primary CTA to begin.

wizard_steps.title: Administrator
wizard_steps.design_instructions: Centered clean form. Inputs for Email, Username, Password, Confirm Password. Use eye icon (Lucide Eye/EyeOff) to toggle password visibility. Single-column.

wizard_steps.title: Server Identity
wizard_steps.design_instructions: Input for 'Server Name'. Below it, a grid of 5-6 color swatches (buttons) to select a theme. Active theme should instantly update the primary accent color of the OOBE UI.

wizard_steps.title: FFmpeg Diagnostic
wizard_steps.design_instructions: Retro-Futuristic 'Terminal' card. Dark bg-zinc-950, mono font. Show Detected (green) or Not Found (red). Include a code block with the install command (e.g., apt install ffmpeg) and a copy button. 'Re-check' button at bottom.

wizard_steps.title: First Library
wizard_steps.design_instructions: Path input field (e.g., /media/movies). Below, 4 large Bento-style selectable cards for type (Movies, TV, Music, Anime) using icons. Skip button below primary action.

wizard_steps.title: License Edition
wizard_steps.design_instructions: 3 tier cards in a grid. Free (subtle), Pro (glassy), Ultra (Tracing beam or glowing amber border). Serial key input below the cards.

wizard_steps.title: You're all set
wizard_steps.design_instructions: Celebratory summary. List of configured items with checkmarks. 'Launch WatchNexus' big CTA. Confetti/Pulse animation.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React 18 JS application, NOT TypeScript. Do not use .tsx extensions.
Eradicate any existing purple/violet AI-slop gradients. Implement the strict Obsidian/Amber premium cinematic palette defined here.
Use framer-motion's <AnimatePresence> and <motion.div> to wrap the wizard steps for smooth sliding/fading transitions.
Create a persistent left sidebar containing the progress rail. On mobile, this should collapse to a top horizontal bar.
Integrate the existing language picker component into the top-right corner of the layout (absolute or fixed positioning).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selectable cards) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute for robust testing (e.g., data-testid='admin-email-input').
Use standard Tailwind classes. For glassmorphism, combine 'backdrop-blur-xl', 'bg-white/5', and 'border border-white/10'.
Ensure the wizard blocks access to the main app until completed.
Install any missing dependencies like lucide-react or framer-motion if they are not already in package.json.
